# Scanned materials
These 1K photographic color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps are from Poly Haven and released under CC0.

- Aerial Grass Rock — Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_grass_rock
- Aerial Asphalt 01 — Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/aerial_asphalt_01
- Brick Wall 003 — Dimitrios Savva and Rob Tuytel: https://polyhaven.com/a/brick_wall_003

License: https://polyhaven.com/license

Architecture, road geometry, facades, vegetation layout, terrain and water shader are generated by the application. Cities: Skylines II screenshots are used only as visual references and are not included in this repository.
